Percival x Front Office: Limited edition collaboration.
It started with a chance meeting in the Percival store. A conversation between Front Office’s Ken Sakata and our founder, Chris Gove, quickly sparked a shared vision: to reimagine the most iconic piece of British outerwear, the Mac.
The Mac is a cornerstone of British style, born in the industrial landscape of 19th-century Manchester. We didn't want to change its soul; we wanted to perfect its purpose.
The Mac features a sharp, set-in sleeve front for formal structure balanced by a raglan back for fluid motion. Designed for the city, it offers seamless utility through a concealed commuter card sleeve, an integrated carabiner, and a traditional map pocket. Cut from premium peached finish cotton, the design is elevated by multi-stitch detailing, a bespoke cut-and-sew hanger loop, and an exclusive embroidered collaboration tab.
True to the garment’s origins, this release is made in Manchester, England. By returning to the Mac's birthplace, we’re honouring the history of UK manufacturing while looking toward its future.
Strictly limited to 30 pieces worldwide, this is a celebration of understated outerwear at its most refined.

I know we say this again and again, but this is a true classic. Hardy chambray shirts were the workforce shirt used by everyone from US Naval Sailors, railroad workers out west, to grainbasket farmers and their families. Loved by Paul Newman in "Cool Hand Luke" and evolved into a Rivera staple in the 60s and 70s. Chambray pairs equally well with blue jeans as it does with khakis and suitings. The Wythe chambray used indigo dyed yarns chosen carefully for their irregular slubs to retain the same character as the original chambrays that had to last for years and years without wearing out or growing thin. The workshirt has all the features youd expect from early 20th century workshirts, like two large front pockets, triple needle overlocked stitching, side seam gussets, and a throat latch. Natural corozo nut buttons dyed a light indigo blue really bring this shirt up a notch while still retaining the feeling of the original workshirts.
